none: PAS CAM-6A9891: Roman Coin : Nummus, of the House of Constantine: CONSTANTINOPOLIS, AD330-331
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Copper-Alloy Nummus, of the House of Constantine: CONSTANTINOPOLIS, AD330-331 (Reece period 17). Reverse legend is unreadable. Reverse shows Victory on prow. Mint is Trier, AD330-331. See RIC, vol.VII, p215, no.530. Obverse legend reads: CONSTANTINOPOLIS. Obverseshows Helmeted bust of Constantinopolis I. Reverse fields and exergue reads: -//TRP. Die axis is 12 o'clock. Weight 1.81g, diameter…
